dedupe_keys.name: proportion of irrigation versus actual irrigation

description: The deposit compares estimated irrigation needs with actual irrigation across districts using statistical tables and plotted comparisons. This resource is provided by Sunil Maria Benedict. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The metadata does not identify the districts or observation period, limiting transfer to operational demand models. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iiasa-cwatm-community-water-model. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
